title: How to spot a kingfisher in 3 steps
caption:
Three steps, no gear needed.

A common kingfisher is only about 17 cm long, which is why it is so easy to miss on a busy riverbank. Pied kingfishers do something most kingfishers don't: they can swallow small fish in flight.
